theater: 安徽銅陵池州段長江丁家洲

battle.name: 丁家洲之戰
battle.theater: 安徽銅陵池州段長江丁家洲
battle.brief: 咸淳元年（1275）三月，元丞相伯顏自池州順流而進，突擊駐紮銅陵丁家洲的南宋大軍。元軍造載薪柴的大筏佯作火攻，以兩岸巨砲、床弩配合騎兵與戰船同時發動，擊潰賈似道所部十三萬精兵，長江下游自此失守；配重投石車一類遠程拋射機，正是這套岸射火力的技術同源。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方是元朝與南宋。元軍由元世祖忽必烈統籌全局，以左丞相、八鄰部人伯顏為南征總主帥，率荊襄戰場解繩之師順長江東下，副手為平章政事阿朮；水師舟船之外，並有自襄陽歸附的降將劉整獻策，主張大造舟師、操練水軍，以水軍配合大軍順流直下。降附的宋人、漢軍與色目、探馬赤等兵種編入各路，由主帥節制。宋方由丞相、平章軍國重事賈似道總領兵馬：先鋒孫虎臣統七萬精銳屯駐銅陵縣城北面的丁家洲，老將夏貴領二千五百戰船封鎖江面，賈似道自領後軍駐蕪湖魯港，十三萬大軍沿池口、銅陵、魯港一線布開。沿江的黃州、蕲州、江州、安慶、池州等州郡在元軍壓力下望風而降，江防體系一節一節地鬆動，而真正的接觸則集中在銅陵江面不足百里的一段。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Yuan dynasty and the Southern Song. On the Yuan side the war was directed from the top by the emperor Kublai Khan, who appointed the left chancellor Bayan of the Barin tribe as commander-in-chief of the southern campaign. Bayan took the army untied from the Jingxiang theatre and sent it down the Yangtze, with the vice chancellor Arzhun as his second in command. Besides the war flotilla, the Yuan drew on the Song general Liu Zheng, who had surrendered after the fall of Xiangyang and pressed the need to build large war vessels, drill a river fleet, and send army and fleet down the river together. Han Chinese troops who had come over to the Yuan, together with Semu and darughachi contingents, were distributed among the columns and remained under the commander's hand. On the Song side the chancellor and holder of the office pingzhang junguo zhongshi, Jia Sidao, was given overall charge of the host: the vanguard under Sun Huchen, 70,000 picked troops, was stationed at Dingjia Zhou north of the county seat of Tongling; the veteran Xia Gui took 2,500 war vessels to seal the river; Jia Sidao himself led the rearguard at Lugang on the Wuhu side, the whole force of 130,000 men being spread in a line from Chikou through Tongling to Lugang. The Yangtze prefectures of Huangzhou, Qizhou, Jiangzhou, Anqing and Chizhou had surrendered as the Yuan pressed forward, the river defence coming apart section by section, while the real contact between the two armies was compressed into barely a hundred li of river off Tongling.
people: 元方最關鍵的人是伯顏。鄂州既下，他沒有按忽必烈詔令停在池州，而是趁大雨之後江水上漲之際自池州發兵，把計策的核心放在欺騙宋軍的注意力上：以載滿薪柴的大筏佯作火攻，誘使宋軍水師把精銳調向水面一側，自己則令兩岸巨砲與床弩就位，等宋軍中堅艦船進入射程，再以騎兵與戰船同時突擊。平章政事阿朮是這次主戰的推手，他力主乘勝進擊並願承擔敗責，元軍的戰船與兩岸騎兵由他率領突前。降將劉整早已把宋軍水戰的虛實講得很清楚，後來元軍在焦山、魯港再用的仍是同一套路。宋方的關鍵人物是賈似道：鄂州失陷後他受朝野催促，率十三萬精兵出川，然而遇挫即鳴金收兵，全軍潰散，他本人逃往揚州；孫虎臣不戰而走，逃往泰州；夏貴的船隊同樣西走，逃往廬州。此役之後，擔任宰相十六年的賈似道下台，後來在謫放途中被殺。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Yuan side was Bayan. With Ezhou already taken, he did not stay at Chizhou as Kublai's edict required; instead he set out from Chizhou after the rains raised the river, and put the centre of his plan on deceiving the Song about where the blow would fall. He had large rafts loaded with firewood built to look like a fire attack, which drew the Song fleet's attention to the open water, while he himself had the great cannons and fixed crossbows on both banks emplaced and waited for the backbone ships of the Song fleet to come within range, then attacked simultaneously with the cavalry and the boats. The vice chancellor Arzhun was the man pushing hardest for the advance; he insisted on pressing the advantage and was willing to take personal responsibility if it failed, and it was his war boats and the cavalry on the banks that led the assault. The surrendered general Liu Zheng had already spelled out the weakness of Song river warfare in plain terms, and the Yuan used the same method again at Jiao Shan and at Lugang. The key figure on the Song side was Jia Sidao. After the loss of Ezhou the court clamoured for him to take command in person, and he marched out with 130,000 picked troops; but the moment the fighting turned he sounded the retreat, the whole army dissolved, and he himself fled to Yangzhou. Sun Huchen broke off without a blow and ran for Taizhou, and Xia Gui's flotilla likewise withdrew west to Luzhou. After this campaign the chancellor, who had held office for sixteen years, was pushed out of power and was later killed on the road to his place of exile.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是配重投石車，即以長臂末端承重、配重下墜帶動的拋射機，自十一、十二世紀起成熟，攻城與野戰都用它把石彈甚至火球拋向遠處，是當時最具殺傷力的遠程火力之一。丁家洲之戰的記載並沒有點名某一具配重投石車，但元軍在此役的火力配置與它同屬一套技術家族：兩岸架設的巨砲與床弩一頭一尾地痛擊宋軍中堅艦船，而伯顏用來欺敵的載薪柴大筏，正是投石機投放火油火球一類火攻器具的放大版本。火藥在宋元兩軍都已用於戰場，元軍的火藥箭與震天雷筒炮，與配重投石車同樣是把能量一次釋放、射程數百步的拋射物。宋軍方面的裝備則是江南造船業的成果：樓船、海船、走舸、鬥艦各司其用，大型海船吃水深、載彈藥與士兵多，卻轉向遲緩，而床弩與巨砲的射程及破甲能力，正是這種重舟最怕的東西。兩軍都靠騎兵沿兩岸護住舟師，糧秣則由江南漕運供應。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the counterweight trebuchet, the throwing engine in which a counterweight falls at the end of a long arm and drives the missile, a design mature from the eleventh and twelfth centuries onward. It was used in siege and in the field to hurl stones and even fireballs, and it was one of the most destructive long-range weapons of its age. The record of the battle of Dingjia Zhou does not name any particular counterweight trebuchet, but the Yuan firepower in this campaign belongs to the same family of technology: the great cannons and fixed crossbows emplaced on both banks hammered the backbone ships of the Song fleet from either end, while the great rafts loaded with firewood that Bayan used as a deception are the enlarged form of the fire attack implements that a trebuchet threw, oil and fireballs and the like. Gunpowder was already in use in the field on both sides, and the Yuan fire arrows and thunder crash bombs released their energy in a single burst over several hundred paces, exactly as the trebuchet did. The Song equipment was the work of the shipyards of the lower Yangtze: tower ships, sea ships, light runners and fighting galleys each had their part, and the big sea ships, deep in the water and able to carry ammunition and soldiers in bulk, were slow to turn, which is precisely what the range and the armour-piercing power of the great cannon and the fixed crossbow exploited. On both sides the cavalry riding along the banks screened the war boats, and the grain and provisions came up the waterways of the south.
tactics: 伯顏的戰法是一套三段式的欺敵與突擊。第一段是造勢：在丁家洲上游的大江面上，造出數只裝載薪柴的大筏，佯作火攻之狀，把宋軍的注意力與船隊調度吸向水面一側。第二段是設伏：元軍在兩岸選擇能俯瞰江面的位置架設巨砲與床弩，並把騎兵分列岸線，準備在宋軍中堅艦船進入射程時齊射。第三段是合擊：元軍戰船順流而下，兩岸騎兵同時發動，先以巨砲、床弩打掉宋軍的骨幹艦船，再以舟師與騎兵一鼓而下，把宋軍在江面上的縱深陣形打成碎片。時機的挑選同樣關鍵，忽必烈的詔令要按兵不動，元軍卻抓住大雨之後江水上漲、順流衝擊更有力的機會。宋軍的崩潰則是從指揮開始的：孫虎臣、夏貴一觸即走，賈似道鳴金收兵，十三萬大軍在沒有縱深、沒有後援的江灘上自行瓦解，元軍隨即沿江追擊，繳獲大批物資、兵器與戰船。教訓很直接：把重兵押在一段江面上而讓岸線與後方空著，等於把整支水軍送到對岸的投射火力之下。
tacticsEn: Bayan fought in three stages, deception and then assault. The first was display: on the broad water upstream of Dingjia Zhou he built several large rafts loaded with firewood and made them look like the advance guard of a fire attack, drawing the attention of the Song and pulling the movement of their fleet towards the open water. The second was the ambush: the Yuan emplaced great cannons and fixed crossbows wherever the banks overlooked the river and posted the cavalry along the shoreline, ready to fire together once the backbone ships of the Song came within range. The third was the combined stroke: the Yuan war boats came down with the current while the cavalry on both banks moved at the same moment, the great cannon and the fixed crossbow first breaking the ships that carried the Song strength, and the fleet and the horsemen then coming down on them in one rush, so that the depth of the Song formation on the river was shattered into pieces. The choice of moment mattered as much: the edict of Kublai ordered the army to stand still, but the Yuan seized the rise in the river after the heavy rain, when the running downstream carried more force. The collapse of the Song began at the top: Sun Huchen and Xia Gui broke at the first contact, Jia Sidao sounded the retreat, and the 130,000 men dissolved on the open bank with no depth and no supporting line. The Yuan pursued along the shore and took a large haul of supplies, weapons and war boats. The lesson was plain: to pile the heavy troops on one stretch of river while leaving the banks and the rear open is to hand the whole fleet over to the projectile weapons of the far shore.
data: 可查證的數字集中在時間與編制兩端。時間上，戰役發生於宋德祐元年二月十九，即1275年3月17日（《宋史·瀛國公本紀》與《賈似道列傳》作庚申日），《元史·世祖本紀》與《伯顏列傳》則作二月廿一，即3月19日，兩說相差二日。兵力上，賈似道所集為精兵十三萬，其中先鋒孫虎臣領七萬精銳駐丁家洲，夏貴領戰船二千五百艘封江，賈似道自領後軍在魯港；元軍兵力只說較少，沒有確數，伯顏用來佯裝火攻的大筏記為數只。行政與時序上的數字亦有跡可循：賈似道出任宰相十六年，襄陽在1273年被元軍攻下，鄂州在1275年初淪陷，戰後不到十五日，無為軍、太平州、和州、建康府接連投降。地理上，丁家洲在南宋時只是長江中的一片沙洲，當時江面寬闊，池州至銅陵丁家洲順流約百餘里，伯顏自池州發兵一日而至。雙方的死傷人數、繳獲船數、器械數目與糧秣數量，現存記載都沒有確數，不可臆造。
dataEn: The figures that can be verified sit at the two ends of the story, the timing and the order of battle. On timing: the fight took place on the nineteenth day of the second month of the Deyou era of the Song, 17 March 1275, according to the Annals of the Prince of Yingguo and the biography of Jia Sidao in the History of Song, which count the gengshen day; the Annals of the Shizu and the biography of Bayan in the History of Yuan instead give the twenty-first day of the second month, 19 March, so the two accounts differ by two days. On troops: Jia Sidao had gathered 130,000 picked men, of whom the vanguard under Sun Huchen, 70,000 elite troops, held Dingjia Zhou, while Xia Gui sealed the river with 2,500 war vessels and Jia Sidao took the rearguard at Lugang. The Yuan numbers are given only as few, with no exact figure, and the great rafts used by Bayan for the deception are recorded simply as several. Numbers of an administrative and chronological kind can also be traced: Jia Sidao had been chancellor for sixteen years, Xiangyang fell to the Yuan in 1273, Ezhou was lost in the early months of 1275, and less than fifteen days after the battle the garrisons of Wuwei, Taiping, He and Jiankang surrendered in turn. On geography: Dingjia Zhou in Southern Song times was only a sandbank in the middle of the Yangtze, and the river was wide there; from Chizhou to Dingjia Zhou off Tongling is a little over a hundred li downstream, and Bayan came out of Chizhou to reach it in a single day. Casualty counts, the number of boats taken, the number of engines and the tonnage of provisions on either side are all absent from the surviving record and must not be invented.
cause: 這場衝突是元滅南宋的總體戰略推進到長江中下游的必然產物。1234年蒙古與南宋聯手滅金，雙方隨即翻臉；1267年起元軍長圍襄樊，1273年攻克襄陽，南宋西北門戶洞開；1274年忽必烈下詔全面進攻，以伯顏為南征主帥，1275年初荊襄戰場的元軍主力奪取鄂州，渡過長江天險，沿江州郡隨即望風而降。鄂州失守震動朝野，輿論請賈似道親領兵馬，希望他像十五年前解除鄂州之圍那樣扭轉局勢，賈似道於是抽集精兵十三萬開赴池口。雙方同時都在試探和談：賈似道遣使議和，願按年入貢歲幣，被伯顏拒絕；忽必烈則詔令大軍停在池州按兵不動。伯顏與阿朮力主乘勝進兵，理由是宋軍新集、士氣不整、舟師不習水戰，若等對方部署完成，長江天險就再難跨越。原本可以避免的一場會戰，於是在池州至銅陵的一百餘里江面上被強行打成了決戰。
causeEn: This clash was the inevitable product of the Yuan strategy of destroying the Song reaching the middle and lower Yangtze. In 1234 the Mongols and the Song destroyed Jin together and turned against each other at once; from 1267 the Yuan besieged Xiangyang and Fancheng for years, and the fall of Xiangyang in 1273 opened the north-west gate of the Song defences. In 1274 Kublai Khan ordered the general offensive and put Bayan in command of the southern campaign, and in the early months of 1275 the main Yuan army in the Jingxiang theatre seized Ezhou and crossed the Yangtze barrier, after which the prefectures along the river fell one after another. The loss of Ezhou shook the court, and public opinion called on Jia Sidao to take the field in person, hoping he would turn the situation as he had when he relieved the siege of Ezhou fifteen years earlier, so he gathered 130,000 picked troops and marched to the mouth of the Chikou. At the same time both sides were sounding each other out over a negotiated peace: Jia Sidao sent emissaries offering annual tribute and silk in return for a halt, and Bayan refused; Kublai Khan meanwhile ordered the army to stand fast at Chizhou. Bayan and Arzhun pressed for the advance while the advantage lasted, on the ground that the Song army was newly assembled, hollow in its morale and unversed in river fighting, and that once the other side finished its preparations the Yangtze barrier would never be crossed again. A meeting that could have been avoided was thus forced into a decisive battle on the hundred-odd li of river between Chizhou and Tongling.
impact: 丁家洲一役之後，長江下游的戰局整個改寫。元軍在江面上取得主動，沿江的無為軍、太平州、和州、建康府在戰後不到十五日內接連投降，元軍取得長江下游的掌控權，切斷了兩淮宋軍與首都臨安的聯繫，臨安第一次直接暴露在北方騎兵與水師的刀鋒之下。南宋方面損失的是最寶貴的一批精兵：十三萬大軍潰散，舟師與器械被繳獲，兩淮防線自此空虛，之後再無足夠的野戰兵力可用。宋廷政局也隨之震動，任相十六年的賈似道威信崩塌而下台，謫放途中被殺，朝廷在倉促中換上新的主持者，再也拿不出對策。技術層面的教訓同樣清楚：在水面寬闊的長江上決戰，岸上的遠程投射火力——巨砲、床弩、火藥箭——對吃水深、轉向遲緩的重型戰艦具有壓倒性的優勢，後來焦山、魯港的戰鬥裡元軍再用的仍是同一套辦法；而配重投石車這類能夠拋射石彈與火球的工程器械，其在攻城與水戰兩端的價值，也在這類戰役中被一再證明。
impactEn: After the battle of Dingjia Zhou the whole situation in the lower Yangtze was rewritten. The Yuan took the initiative on the water, and within less than fifteen days the garrisons of Wuwei, Taiping, He and Jiankang surrendered one after another. The Yuan gained control of the lower river, cut the two Huai regions off from the capital at Lin'an, and for the first time left Lin'an directly exposed to the blades of northern cavalry and river fleets. What the Song lost was its most valuable body of picked troops: 130,000 men scattered, the war boats and engines taken as booty, and the defences of the two Huai regions left hollow, with never again enough field troops to put against the enemy. The politics of the court were shaken as well. Jia Sidao, chancellor for sixteen years, lost his standing, was pushed out of office and was killed on the road to exile, and the court hastily put new men in his place without finding any answer to the crisis. The technical lesson was just as clear: in a battle fought on the broad waters of the Yangtze, long-range projectile fire from the banks — great cannons, fixed crossbows, fire arrows — had a decisive advantage over heavy warships that drew deep water and turned slowly. The method the Yuan used again at Jiao Shan and at Lugang was the same one. And engines of the trebuchet type, able to hurl stones and fireballs, saw their worth demonstrated again and again on both sides of the wall, in siege and in river fight alike.
result: 結局是元軍大勝、南宋主力崩潰。接觸之初，孫虎臣與夏貴所部便不戰而走，賈似道鳴金收兵，十三萬大軍頃刻瓦解，元軍以騎兵與舟師追擊於江岸，繳獲大量物資、兵器與戰船；賈似道逃往揚州，孫虎臣逃往泰州，夏貴逃往廬州。戰後不到十五日，無為軍、太平州、和州、建康府等州郡接連投降，元軍取得長江下游的掌控權並旋即攻占建康，臨安門戶洞開。南宋折損的兵員、器械與船數沒有確切記載，但可以確定的是，此役之後南宋在江淮與兩浙再也組織不出對等的野戰兵團，賈似道下台並在謫放途中被殺，宋廷自此以守禦江口為唯一方略。同年十月元軍又在焦山與宋軍水師交鋒，沿江防線已無縱深可守；次年建康失守，臨安門戶洞開。丁家洲因此成為元滅南宋過程中第一場決定長江下游歸屬的會戰。
resultEn: The outcome was a great Yuan victory and the collapse of the main Song force. At the first contact the troops of Sun Huchen and Xia Gui broke off without a blow, Jia Sidao sounded the retreat, and the 130,000 men came apart at once; the Yuan pursued along the bank with cavalry and boats and took a large haul of supplies, weapons and war vessels. Jia Sidao fled to Yangzhou, Sun Huchen to Taizhou and Xia Gui to Luzhou. Less than fifteen days later the prefectures of Wuwei, Taiping, He and Jiankang surrendered in turn, the Yuan gained control of the lower Yangtze and went on to take Jiankang, leaving Lin'an wide open. The number of men, engines and boats the Song lost is not exactly recorded, but what is certain is that after this campaign the Song could no longer raise a field army of comparable strength in the Jianghuai and the Two Zhe regions, and that Jia Sidao was driven from office and killed on the road to exile. From then on the Song court had nothing left but to hold the river mouths. In the tenth month of the same year the Yuan fought the Song fleet again at Jiao Shan, with no depth left anywhere in the river defence, and in the following year Jiankang fell and Lin'an was left open. Dingjia Zhou was therefore the first great engagement to decide the fate of the lower Yangtze in the process of the Yuan conquest of the Song.
